summary: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions Inc. filed an 8-K solely to furnish a press release announcing its subsidiary's participation in an upcoming security trade show (GSX 2026), including an education session and product demonstrations at partner booths. The filing is routine promotional activity with no financial terms, transactions, or special-situation events. No strategic or corporate action is described. The 8-K is furnished under Item 8.01 and explicitly disclaims materiality. This is not a special situation; it is an ordinary current report about marketing presence.
